results.query: show customer names with their orders
list all orders with customer information
results.sql:
SELECT 
    o.id AS order_id,
    c.id AS customer_id,
    c.name AS customer_name,
    c.email AS customer_email,
    o.product_name,
    o.quantity,
    o.order_date,
    o.total_price
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id;

results.query: get customer email addresses for each order
show which customers placed orders
display orders along with customer names
count orders per customer
results.sql:
SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.name;

results.query: total quantity ordered by each customer
results.sql:
SELECT c.name, SUM(o.quantity) AS total_quantity_ordered
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.name;

results.query: average order price per customer
results.sql:
SELECT c.name, AVG(o.total_price) AS average_order_price
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.name;

results.query: number of products per price range
results.sql:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN p.price BETWEEN 0 AND 99.99 THEN '0-99.99'
        WHEN p.price BETWEEN 100 AND 199.99 THEN '100-199.99'
        WHEN p.price BETWEEN 200 AND 299.99 THEN '200-299.99'
        ELSE '300+' 
    END AS price_range,
    COUNT(p.id) AS product_count
FROM 
    products p
GROUP BY 
    price_range;

results.query: sum of order totals grouped by customer
results.sql:
SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total_price) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.name;

results.query: find customers who ordered more than 5 items
results.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.name, c.email 
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.quantity > 5;

results.query: show top 10 customers by total spending
results.sql:
SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.total_price) AS total_spending
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY total_spending DESC
LIMIT 10;

results.query: list products never ordered
results.sql:
SELECT p.name 
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN orders o ON p.name = o.product_name
WHERE o.id IS NULL;

results.query: get customers who placed orders in the last month
results.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.name, c.email 
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH);

results.query: find the most expensive order with customer details
results.sql:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.email, o.id AS order_id, o.product_name, o.quantity, o.total_price, o.order_date
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
ORDER BY o.total_price DESC
LIMIT 1;
